purpose: Test whether the Gate B representation generalises across the full 36-row Staringreeks 2018 homogeneous unimodal Mualem-van Genuchten material catalog without changing representation, node density, face geometry or acceptance thresholds.

constitutive_scope.retention: unimodal van Genuchten effective saturation with m=1-1/n
constitutive_scope.conductivity: Mualem-van Genuchten using KSATFIT and LEXP
constitutive_scope.ksatexm: disabled in C1 to keep the constitutive law identical in form to qualified Gate B
constitutive_scope.h_enpr: all catalog rows have H_ENPR=0 but enhanced near-saturated conductivity is explicitly outside C1

qualification_probes_per_material.seed_rule: integer from first 8 hex digits of sha256('F-ROSS01-C1:'+material), reduced to uint32

aggregate_decision_rule: C1 PASS only if every one of the 36 frozen materials passes every per-material criterion. Any single material failure rejects C1 fail-closed. No retuning on C1 probes.
scope_guard: Even a C1 PASS does not qualify KSATEXM near-saturated extensions, other SWAP hydraulic model families, saturation transitions, heterogeneous profiles, transient timestep accuracy, process physics, bottom boundary, groundwater, MultiSWAP, real-table response tangents or FullRichards equivalence.
